requirements.description: The property will be converted into a university student residence, so universities and schools must be nearby. Set at the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided. The energy class C preference and the Turin location are not REFERENCE COLUMNS and are handled by other agents.

User prefers energy class C or better, so all classes from C upward (A1 through A4, B, C) are included. The gross floor area (at least 850 sqm), capacity (60 people), Turin location, and CDP/PNRR funding requirements are not energy parameters and are not filtered here.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1–A4, B or C, and education score >= 75. Geographic filter keeps properties within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) using haversine_km on latitude/longitude, ordered by distance ascending. No LIMIT and no comune_code predicate, per the extracted requirements.
